private theorem probeAll {α : Type} {a b : α}
    (cover : ∀ x : α, x = a ∨ x = b) (p : α → Prop) :
    (∀ x, p x) ↔ p a ∧ p b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h a, h b⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩ x

    · simpa only [h] using ha

    · exact Or.inl (h ▸ hx)
    · exact Or.inr (h ▸ hx)
  · rintro (ha | hb)
